It's amazing to see the difference sports make in people's lives.
[D26:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of kids playing basketball in a gym
[D26:22] Tim: Cool! What have been some memorable experiences working with them?
[D26:23] John: Organizing a basketball camp for kids in my hometown last summer was an awesome experience! Seeing their faces light up when they hit the court was priceless. It was a week full of laughs, high-fives, and personal growth for us all. That opportunity to inspire those kids and show them just how much potential they have was truly incredible.
[D26:24] Tim: Wow! Making a difference to those kids was great! Your passion for helping others is awesome.
[D26:24] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a basketball with a signed autograph on it
[D26:25] John: Thanks! I'm really glad I can make a difference. Have you been doing anything new in your free time?
[D26:26] Tim: In my downtime, I still love to get lost in good books, and this series is one of my favorites. It's a magical world to escape to.
[D26:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a collection of harry potter books on a desk
[D26:27] John: That's awesome! Have you seen all the Harry Potter movies? I'm a fan too!

passages.text:
Session date: 7:48 pm on 21 May, 2023
[D1:1] John: Hey Tim, nice to meet you! What's up? Anything new happening?
[D1:2] Tim: Hey John! Great to meet you. Been discussing collaborations for a Harry Potter fan project I am working on - super excited! Anything interesting happening for you?
[D1:3] John: That's great! I just signed with a new team - excited for the season!
[D1:4] Tim: Woohoo! Congrats on the new team. Which team did you sign with?
[D1:5] John: The Minnesota Wolves! I can't wait to play with them!
[D1:6] Tim: Cool! What position are you playing for the team? Any exciting games coming up?
[D1:7] John: I'm a shooting guard for the team and our season opener is next week - so excited!
[D1:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bunch of basketball jerseys laying on a bed
[D1:8] Tim: Cool! Have any goals in mind?
[D1:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a basketball game in progress with the ball in the air
[D1:9] John: Yeah, my goal is to improve my shooting percentage. Been practicing hard and gonna make it happen.
[D1:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two men standing next to a basketball machine
[D1:10] Tim: Sounds good! What challenges have you encountered during your pre-season training?
[D1:11] John: Fitting into the new team's style of play was a challenge during pre-season.
[D1:12] Tim: That sounds rough. How are things going with the new team?
[D1:13] John: Things are going well! The team has been really nice and I'm having fun. How's your fan project coming along?
[D1:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bench in a locker with several lockers behind it
[D1:14] Tim: It's been going well! Last week I talked to my friend who is a fan of Harry Potter and we're figuring out ideas, so it's been great to get lost in that magical world!
[D1:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a table with a bunch of books on it
[D1:15] John: That's great! Loving it when people are passionate about their work. What kind of collaborations are you involved in for the fan project? I love talking to people about my sneaker collection.
[D1:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a circle of shoes on the floor in a room
[D1:16] Tim: Thanks! We'll be discussing various aspects of the Harry Potter universe, like characters, spells, and magical creatures. It's great to see fans coming together for this.
[D1:17] John: Wow! Have you been to any places related to it?
[D1:17] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bookcase filled with books and toys
[D1:18] Tim: I went to a place in London a few years ago - it was like walking into a Harry Potter movie! I also went on a tour which was amazing. Have you been to any of the real Potter places? I'd love to explore them someday!
[D1:19] John: No, but it sounds fun! Going to those places is definitely on my to-do list.
[D1:20] Tim: Definitely add it to your list! It's a really fun experience. Let me know if you need any tips for visiting. Bye!
Session date: 5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023
[D2:1] Tim: Last night I joined a fantasy literature forum and had a great talk about my fave books. It was so enriching!
[D2:2] John: Wow, great to hear that you had a blast talking books! It's cool to connect with others who share your passion. On a different note, exciting things are happening--I'm exploring endorsement opportunities. Thinking about the possibilities pumps me up. It would be amazing to work with brands and do something special. It's so rewarding to have my hard work pay off like this.
[D2:3] Tim: Wow, that's awesome! Congrats - you must be so stoked! Which brands are you looking to link up with?
[D2:4] John: Thanks! I'm really excited about this new journey! I'm currently considering sports brands like Nike and Under Armour. It would be great to collaborate with brands that are related to sports. However, I'm also open to exploring other brands that align with my values and interests. There are so many options out there, and I can't wait to see where this takes me!
[D2:5] Tim: That's awesome! It's gotta be a rush having all these options. Can't wait to see which brands you choose to work with - gonna be great!
[D2:6] John: Thanks! Exciting times ahead! I'll keep you updated on which brands I choose. Can't wait to see where this journey leads me. Thanks for your support.
[D2:7] Tim: Yeah, John! Count on me for support. Can't wait to see what's up! This is my book collection so far.
[D2:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book shelf with books and a picture on it
[D2:8] John: Wow, nice bookshelf! That picture is really interesting. What's up with it?
[D2:9] Tim: Thanks! That picture is from MinaLima. They created all the props for the Harry Potter films, and I love their work. It's like having a piece of the wizarding world at home!
[D2:10] John: Wow, having that is so cool! Your enthusiasm for it is awesome. You really go for it!
[D2:11] Tim: Thanks! I have lots of reminders of it - kind of a way to escape reality.
[D2:12] John: Do those reminders help you escape the daily grind? Any chance you'll visit more places related to that world soon?
[D2:13] Tim: Definitely, those reminders really help. And there's definitely a chance I'll be visiting more HP spots in the future. It feels like I'm stepping into the books!
[D2:14] John: That sounds awesome! So cool that you get to immerse yourself in that world. So glad you found something that brings you so much joy. Keep diving in and enjoying it! Here's a pic from a recent game.
[D2:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a basketball game being played in a gym
[D2:15] Tim: Wow! That's awesome! Were you playing or watching?
[D2:16] John: Thanks! That was from a game I just played. I was in it! It was awesome being out there, doing what I love. Such an awesome feeling.
[D2:17] Tim: Wow! You look so into it in that pic – it must be so awesome playing at that level! Keep rockin' it!
[D2:18] John: Thanks! It's a blast. Giving it my all every time I'm on the court. Really appreciate your support!
[D2:19] Tim: Yeah, keep going! Don't give up on your dreams. Talk to you later!
Session date: 4:21 pm on 16 July, 2023
[D3:1] John: Hey Tim! Good to see you again. So much has happened in the last month - on and off the court. Last week I scored 40 points, my highest ever, and it feels like all my hard work's paying off.
[D3:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a score board with a clock and a phone
[D3:2] Tim: Congrats on your achievement! I'm so proud of you. Last week, I had a nice chat with a Harry Potter fan in California. It was magical!
[D3:2] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a table with a bunch of books on it
[D3:3] John: Thank you! Scoring those points was an incredible experience. The atmosphere was electric, and my teammates and I were thrilled. We pulled off a tough win!
[D3:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of men sitting on top of a basketball court
[D3:4] Tim: Wow, sounds awesome! Winning after that game must have felt amazing - what was it like? Did you celebrate afterward?
[D3:5] John: We were all exhausted but so happy. After that, we celebrated at a restaurant, laughing and reliving the intense moments - it felt amazing!
[D3:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people sitting at a table eating
[D3:6] Tim: Wow, sounds like a blast! I had an incredible time meeting with that fellow fan. You can really feel the love when you're surrounded by people who share the same passion. Does that happen with your sport too?
[D3:7] John: Definitely! Being surrounded by teammates who are equally passionate creates a strong bond. We push each other to be our best and the love for the game is infectious. It's like having a second family.
[D3:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a rack of basketball jerseys in a store

   qualifiers such as "recently", "after the accident" or "during the workshop"
   inside that relation phrase. Never remove a person, time, place, reason or
   other condition merely because a broader atom is easier to match.
2. A chain plan only when an unnamed intermediate entity must genuinely be found.
3. An intersection plan only when the same answer must independently satisfy
   two relations.

Plans must be meaningfully different. Never pad a plan with artificial atoms such
as recent(?x, true), after(?x, event), type_of(?x, requested_type), or an atom
unconnected to the answer path. Never use true, false or yes as an argument.
Preserve relation direction. For "What has Alice bought?", use buy(Alice, ?x).
Use aggregation "set" for all matching members, "count" for a count, and "none"
for one value. max/min/compare are allowed descriptions but are not executable.

{"plans": [
  {"answer_var": "x",
    "atoms": [{"relation": "...", "subject": "...", "object": "?x"}],
    "expected_type": "person|place|date|organization|work|number|other",
    "aggregation": "none|set|max|min|compare|count",
    "fallback": "keyword query"}
]}

Example 2 — a real chain uses an unknown intermediate entity.
Question: "In which city is the laboratory led by Omar located?"
{"plans":[{"answer_var":"x","atoms":[{"relation":"lead","subject":"Omar","object":"?y"},{"relation":"located in","subject":"?y","object":"?x"}],"expected_type":"place","aggregation":"none","fallback":"Omar laboratory city"}]}

Example 3 — an intersection repeats the answer variable because both conditions
must describe the same answer.
Question: "Which researcher works at Northstar Institute and studies coral bleaching?"
{"plans":[{"answer_var":"x","atoms":[{"relation":"work at","subject":"?x","object":"Northstar Institute"},{"relation":"study","subject":"?x","object":"coral bleaching"}],"expected_type":"person","aggregation":"set","fallback":"Northstar researcher coral bleaching"}]}

Example 4 — event context stays in the main predicate. It does not become
`after(?x, conference)` or a boolean atom, and it must not be dropped.
Question: "What exhibition did Jun visit after the conference?"
{"plans":[{"answer_var":"x","atoms":[{"relation":"visit after conference","subject":"Jun","object":"?x"}],"expected_type":"other","aggregation":"none","fallback":"Jun exhibition after conference"}]}

Example 5 — plural enumeration uses set; one witness may prove one member.
Question: "Which dishes did Mateo cook for the festival?"
{"plans":[{"answer_var":"x","atoms":[{"relation":"cook for festival","subject":"Mateo","object":"?x"}],"expected_type":"other","aggregation":"set","fallback":"Mateo festival dishes"}]}

Example 6 — counting retrieves the members to count; the number is not an
invented graph constant.
Question: "How many apprentices joined the observatory?"
{"plans":[{"answer_var":"x","atoms":[{"relation":"join","subject":"?x","object":"the observatory"}],"expected_type":"number","aggregation":"count","fallback":"observatory apprentices joined"}]}
